policy: Before any installer reaches the owner, every requirement must pass on a clean Windows VM against the exact installer bytes identified by SHA-256 (unsigned is accepted and recorded; Defender/SmartScreen are never bypassed), with light and dark screenshots for UI requirements and, for owner-reported regressions, proof the same test failed on the baseline build.

processOwnerItems.16: ux-content-accessibility sign-off includes a visual light/dark review of every changed screen
processOwnerItems.26: growth-website sign-off covers the public website rebrand (PR #51)
processOwnerItems.28: brand-marketing role exists and must sign off

requirements.description: Clean install of the exact SHA-256-identified installer on a fresh Windows VM; Budlark name and icon in installer, Start menu and tray; app launches
Sign in and out with Microsoft and Google accounts; Budlark name on every sign-in screen; account badge shows the user's name, never 'Unknown'
No debug, cache, 'Unknown', raw exception or implementation text on any screen in light or dark mode
Main screen shows only the garden and primary actions; device and garden details live in Settings
Plant flow completes with a suggested and with a custom typed anchor and behavior; custom entry is visible without hunting
Celebration practice is recommended, optional, and explains why it helps
Did it / Did it more / Not today are aligned, clearly buttons, and record a check-in; secondary actions are in the overflow menu
Weekly reflection and other secondary actions open from the overflow menu and save
Copy link creates a working invite link on the installed build
Email invite opens a draft containing the invite link and the chosen recipe card
Show QR renders a scannable QR code for the invite
Windows Share opens the share sheet with the invite and the chosen recipe card
Recipe picker shows real cards matching the main-screen seed card and shares the chosen card with no extra category step
Analytics consent follows the expert-approved design; nothing is collected without consent where law requires it
Ctrl+V paste works in Send Feedback and every other text field
Feedback sends in one step with a star rating and no type choice; the primary action is Send; no technical copy or My Feedback list; the team receives it
Settings shows 4-5 items with 2-3 word labels and info tips, with no long scroll
After a fresh install, reminders and launch at Windows sign-in are ON by default
The Windows reminders toggle turns on and off, persists across restart, and a reminder is delivered
The brand-marketing approved theme, icon, lark motif and names appear on every customer-facing surface
Uninstall leaves no app residue; reinstall and sign-in restore the account
